newsitem.title: USA: StaffMark files shelf for 4.0 mln common.
newsitem.headline: StaffMark files shelf for 4.0 mln common.

text.p: StaffMark Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday for up to 4.0 million common shares.
The Fayetteville, Ark.,-based company said it may issue and offer the shares in the future in connection with the merger with or acquisition by the company of other businesses or assets.

The staffing services company said it currently has 13.3 million common shares listed on the Nasdaq, of which 6.325 are registered and available for unrestricted trading unless owned by its affiliates.
